_DESIGN_RULE: One product per interest, exactly - nine interests, nine products, no gaps and no doubles. The STARTER six are two per category, which is load-bearing twice over: a category read is always actionable, and the Karen's demanded category is always servable. Margins are a ladder deliberately uncorrelated with how often an interest gets ranked highly, so their number one might be the $600 concierge plan while the $1,600 service contract sits seventh - that mismatch is the decision the whole game exists to produce. A new product must take an interest away from an existing one or it does not go in.
